description:
Operation IDs listed here or in receipts are names only. Before the first call to each operation in this conversation, call elevenlabs_discover_api with that operation_id to read its contract, unless a tool description or receipt already supplies the exact parameter names and locations. Never infer path_params, query_params or body fields from an operation name.
Generate or process audio and media using an admitted operation_id.
WHEN TO USE: requested speech, dialogue, sound, music, transcription, alignment, voice-preview, asynchronous image, video and speech generation, and new media-training jobs. Explicit webhook selection asks the provider to deliver results to configured workspace Flows webhooks. Discover the exact contract first. Requests may create provider records. Local files use declared file operands. Successful submission may still be queued or processing, not finished media. Streaming responses are collected into files with metadata before return, not live playback. Existing-resource edits, regeneration and deletion use their corresponding tools. No retry, polling, delivery or recipient contact is automatic.
RELATED TOOLS: elevenlabs_discover_api, elevenlabs_read_resource, elevenlabs_change_resource, elevenlabs_delete_resource.
EXAMPLE: elevenlabs_discover_api({"query":"speech"}).
COST: generation and processing may consume credits.

body.description: The provider request body for this operation, preserving its schema, arrays and nulls. Omit for bodyless operations; local file operands belong in files.

path_params.description: Declared path parameter names and nonempty string values; inspect this operation with elevenlabs_discover_api.

query_params.description: Declared query parameter names with string, number, boolean, null or scalar-array values. Arrays repeat; null is omitted.
